segments.name: Just – Evotec Biologics
products: single-use disposable, perfusion-based continuous bioprocessing platforms
segments.description: Discovers, optimizes, develops and manufactures bio-therapeutics for pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners, from early stage to commercial biomanufacturing.
segments.evidence: Just – Evotec Biologics is our advanced approach to discovering, optimizing, developing and manufacturing bio-therapeutics.

segments.name: Discovery & Preclinical Development
products: drug discovery and preclinical development services
segments.description: Provides drug discovery and preclinical development services and solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners, from patient-data-derived ideas through to IND application.
segments.evidence: D&PD primarily includes drug discovery and preclinical development services and solutions, starting with sourcing novel treatment ideas derived from patient data and continues with target validation and lead optimization.

revenueModel.text: Evotec is paid by pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners primarily through fee-for-service and FTE-rate contracts, plus milestone and royalty payments on partnered assets and technology licenses.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue primarily through three core collaboration routes: (1) by providing our drug discovery and development capabilities on a fee-for-service and FTE-rate basis; (2) by receiving milestones and royalties on partnered assets; and (3) by creating value through equity ownership in emerging, highly innovative biotechnology companies and translational academic institutional projects.

changes.text: In 2024, Evotec replaced its former EVT Execute and EVT Innovate segments with the new reportable segments Shared R&D and Just – Evotec Biologics.
changes.evidence: As of January 1, 2024, a new segment reporting was introduced and moved from the segments EVT Execute and EVT Innovate towards Shared R&D and Just – Evotec Biologics to better steer our business and to reflect the underlying trends, evolutions and activities of the various business areas we are involved in.

changes.text: In 2025, the segment formerly known as Shared R&D was renamed Discovery & Preclinical Development.
changes.evidence: In 2025, the Management Board made the decision to rename the segment previously known as "Shared R&D" to Discovery & Preclinical Development ("D&PD") to better reflect Evotec's strategic focus.

changes.text: In 2025, Evotec sold its Just - Evotec Biologics EU SAS subsidiary in Toulouse, France to Sandoz AG, exiting large-scale biologics manufacturing at that site.
changes.evidence: By share purchase agreement (SPA) signed on November 4, 2025 and with closing effective as of December 5, 2025, Evotec SE disposed of 100 % of the shares in its subsidiary Just - Evotec Biologics EU SAS, Toulouse, France (subsequently: Just EU) to Sandoz AG, Basel, Switzerland.
